finding.issue: The current-main integration copied TASK-082 documentation forward without reconciling it to the final reviewed F1 safety boundary or to TASK-084's actual integration/publication lineage. README still says crash re-delivery may reconcile a "uniquely attributable new REMEDIATION RUN" after interruption, while the integrated implementation intentionally refuses all unbound later RUN attribution and permits reconciliation only for the exact RUN already durably bound to the correction dispatch. The roadmap also says A6 is "DONE BY TASK-082 UPON PUBLICATION" and makes completion authoritative only if the TASK-082 candidate itself is published, even though TASK-082's reviewed candidate is intentionally divergent and TASK-084 exists precisely to create the separately verified current-main descendant that can be published. Leaving these statements in product main would make the documented A6 safety/completion contract disagree with the implementation and immutable publication lineage.
